extracted.name: Olive, cauliflower & harissa pasta
extracted.description: Harissa adds colour and warmth to this vegan midweek pasta dish, with fried cauliflower, green olives and parsley. Add more harissa, if you like it spicy
ingredient_lines: 1 small cauliflower broken into small florets, stalks and leaves finely chopped
150g dairy-free wholemeal pasta of your choice (such as pappardelle; gluten-free if needed)
small handful of parsley finely chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat and tip in the cauliflower florets, stalks and leaves. Season, cover and fry for 8-10 mins, shaking the pan now and then, until lightly browned and softened. Stir the tomato purée and tomatoes, cover and cook for 5 mins more until the tomatoes have burst. Add the garlic, olives and harissa, and cook for 2-3 mins until fragrant.

Meanwhile, cook the pasta following pack instructions. Drain, reserving a mugful of the water. Stir the pasta and a splash of the water into the tomato mixture. Season, scatter over the parsley and serve.
